On his journey, he came to a wealthy family and learned that Chen Huishu, the lady of the house, had long suffered from gynecological problems.
Chu Bai took an unconventional approach and decided to treat her with his unique medical methods.
During the treatment, his repeated sincere gestures gradually made Chen Huishu let down her guard.

dramaora_52029056458_1.synopsis: Caleb Collins lost his mother in a suspicious childhood accident and was cast out by his father. Years later, disguised as a blind masseur, he was hired by Vivian Harper—only to find her husband was his own father, Nathaniel Collins. While passing the family's tests, he uncovered clues linking his mother's death to three women: Vivian, her daughter Yune, and secretary Juliet Jean. Caleb began quietly probing them to unearth the buried truth.

dramaora_52028699581_1.synopsis: Henry had been single for 20 years until an antique dealer, Mandy, took an interest in his family heirloom jade pendant. Mandy asked Henry’s daughter, Cindy, to send a seemingly innocent college girl, Jade, into Henry’s life to seduce him. However, Henry resisted the temptation. Frustrated, Mandy took matters into her own hands but failed. Meanwhile, Jade, overwhelmed by guilt, confessed the truth to Song. What will happen next for them?

dramaora_52022080869_1.synopsis: Tired of eternal life and endless scheming in the divine realm, the God of Tricks abandoned his godhood and descended to Earth as Wyatt Hale. He stroke a deal with the pure-hearted Sia Elowen to pretend to be her boyfriend and fended off her family's marriage pressure. Their playful fake relationship was filled with hilarious misunderstandings, and Wyatt's centuries-old icy heart gradually melted. As Sia unknowingly fell for the mysterious man, the trickster god gave up his manipulative games and fell deeply in love. Finally, he chose to leave his divine powers behind forever and spent the rest of his mortal days happily with Sia.

dramaora_52024246190_1.synopsis: In a remote village, a well-known fox hunter Frank Young ignores his wife Karen Young’s warnings against reckless killing. Soon, fox spirits seek revenge: the family’s livestock are killed, and their grandson Max Young is trapped in eerie illusions and constant nightmares. Frank turns to villagers for help to fight the foxes, only to plunge the boy into deeper torment. At last, moved by Max’s earnest begging, Frank repents and gives up hunting forever.

The female lead was originally an ordinary girl striving to make a living in an ordinary world, but due to a sudden family 变故 (family misfortune), she was thrown into the world of the tycoon. The tycoon, who dominates the business world and controls billions of wealth, possesses a powerful aura, and his world is cold and full of calculations.
By chance, the female lead 闯入 (stumbled into) the tycoon's field of vision due to a last-resort act, and the tycoon developed a deep interest in her. From then on, the female lead's life underwent earth-shattering changes. In the name of love, the tycoon imprisoned the female lead by his side, and since then, he has launched a series of methods to pursue her.

dramaora_52024390680_1.synopsis:
Elena was once a promising law student with a bright future, but she set aside her career aspirations to support her lover, Asher, in his startup, devoting herself to being his pillar of strength. She poured all her passion into their shared dream, hoping for a blissful future together. However, her selfless dedication was met with betrayal, as Zhao's repeated infidelity shattered her trust.

Despite her deep love, Elena initially chose forgiveness, attempting to salvage their crumbling relationship. Yet, faced with unrepentant betrayal, she came to a hard realization: only by reclaiming herself could she find true freedom and purpose. Resolutely, she severed ties with Asher and embarked on a journey of rebirth.

Returning to her legal roots, she rebuilt her career and crossed paths with a former senior who had long admired her. Though his renewed affection was sincere, Elena focused on her work, striving to fulfill the aspirations she once set aside. As she ascended the ranks and achieved professional excellence, Asher finally recognized what he had lost. But by then, Elena had transformed into the indomitable "Queen of the Courtroom", radiating strength and independence in her renewed life.

dramaora_52022186323_1.synopsis: Wendy has been tirelessly searching for her missing lover, but the amnesia caused by a car accident prevents her from recalling his face. Then, her adoptive brother, Zane, appears, speaking with a familiar tone and claiming he will protect her. Convinced she has found her long-lost love, her certainty is shattered when Ryan, the CEO of the Chen Corporation, suddenly shows up. Zane is forced to jump from a building, and the Zhou family is engulfed in scandal. Trapped like a caged bird, Wendy desperately seeks her true lover, only to discover that the familiar tenderness she craves has been with her all along.

dramaora_52022184597_1.synopsis:
Devastated by the tragic destruction of her family, Su Dan seeks release through suicide, unwittingly awakening the lingering spirit of Daji. Determined to wield the sword of vengeance for Su Dan, Daji reincarnates within her body, using her unparalleled allure to manipulate three men: Du Tianlin—husband of Gu Yi, Gu Jiucheng—her son, and Mr. Huang—Gu Yi's lover, turning them all into pawns under her control.  
In a battle of seduction and wits, Su Dan and Gu Yi engage in an intense rivalry for dominance over the men in their lives. Gu Yi, desperate to protect her position, resorts to extreme measures but falls deeper into the intricate traps set by Su Dan. Ultimately, Su Dan's meticulously executed revenge leaves Gu Yi disgraced, exiled from her former world, and utterly alone.  
However, in this tale fueled by hatred, even victory feels hollow—there are no true winners in a war of vengeance.

She will reclaim everything and shine brighter once again. At the funeral, billionaire Ian Somberland suddenly appears, stepping forward to protect her... This time, she is not fighting alone!

She will reclaim everything and shine brighter once again. At the funeral, billionaire Ian Somberland suddenly appears, stepping forward to protect her... This time, she is not fighting alone!
